sprint_bouncy.enter: rpm >= 85 AND intensity_ratio >= 0.35 OR (intensity_ratio >= 1.00 AND rpm >= 65)

transitions.note: If the app has a route grade or workout segment signal, use it to identify the hill and crest. Otherwise the watt/FTP and RPM conditions are only a visual heuristic.

notes: Thresholds are editable example defaults, not personalized training advice.
FTP must be set above zero before calculating intensity_ratio.
Keep transition clips one-shot; only idle/run/sprint_bouncy/climb_loop are loops.
The climb loop is authored as a forward-and-back cycle to make its seam continuous.
Pause overrides all motion and selects idle.
